WITH baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS baseline_avg
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
combination_averages AS (
    SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref
    JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
combination_deviations AS (
    SELECT ca.transref, ca.tradekind, ca.avg_optvolrt,
           ca.avg_optvolrt - b.baseline_avg AS deviation
    FROM combination_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation
    FROM combination_deviations
    WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY tradekind
),
kept AS (
    SELECT cd.tradekind, cd.avg_optvolrt, cd.deviation,
           cd.deviation - ta.avg_deviation AS excess
    FROM combination_deviations AS cd
    JOIN type_averages AS ta ON ta.tradekind = cd.tradekind
    WHERE cd.deviation > ta.avg_deviation
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept
GROUP BY tradekind;
